column4: Registries (population, land, address, etc.). **At country level, registry material files under `--dpi-id`, not a separate `--dpi-registry` intersection** *(ruled 2026-08-10, token review task 7, housekeeping job 37)*: in practice registry and identity development has always been reported together, so no `{place}--dpi-registry` page is minted — a country's registry facts live in its `--dpi-id` page and `dpi.registry` itself stays a thematic page with `## By place` as index-plus-links, same as any other concept page's over-bar cells (`reference.md` §8).
